description: National Water Model COMIDs for Texas Bridges is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Carter, Andy (deposited on HydroShare). This is a JSON file listing 10697 COMIDs representing features of the US National Water Model that are crossed by a bridge in Texas. Current and past forecasts of the NWM for these features can be retrieved using the NWM API under development by BYU through funding from NOAA and CIROH. Coverage: Texas, United States. The resource was created 2023-11-08 and last updated 2023-11-14; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
